headline: Cisco patches exploited ASA/FTD VPN zero-day that crashes firewalls; China-linked ESX zero-day; PHP2Shell KEV deadline today

bullets.text: New: Cisco has patched CVE-2026-76418, an actively exploited zero-day in ASA and FTD VPN that attackers are using to crash SSL VPN devices. It is the second Cisco firewall VPN zero-day exploited since August.
New: Cisco SD-WAN zero-day exploitation has been tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network, which researchers say hid four zero-day campaigns.
China-linked actors used ESX logging flaw CVE-2026-41709, rated low severity, as a zero-day to reduce audit trail visibility. CISA added it to KEV on 2026-10-28 with a federal due date of 2026-11-11.

PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) rooted 25 servers and breached a U.S. government-affiliated network. CISA's due date is today, 2026-10-29; fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

KEV deadlines: Linux kernel CVE-2026-46300 is due 2026-10-31; Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Google Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are due 2026-11-10. Separately, an attacker tried to exploit Alpine Linux's GitLab via CVSS 10.0 flaw CVE-2026-97229.

Breaches: hackers stole 2.6 million records from Sony's Japanese ISP So-net; hacktivists leaked records on 41,000 DHS staff, including undercover ICE agents; an HHS filing puts the iRhythm toll at 8.2 million.

actions: Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418 now and review VPN logs and device crashes for signs of exploitation.
Check Cisco SD-WAN deployments against Cisco's advisories and hunt for Volt Typhoon activity described in the Silent Train reporting.
Finish PHP updates to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 today, including firewalls and appliances, and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Patch VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709 per Broadcom's advisory despite its low score, and review ESX hosts for audit logging gaps.
Apply your distribution's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31, starting with multi-user and internet-facing Linux hosts.
Patch self-hosted GitLab for CVE-2026-97229 and patch Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 before 2026-11-10.
